revenue_growth.source: Assumption: FY2025 growth 5.1% and FY2026 4.7% (computed from 10-K 0000104169-26-000055 revenue); fade from ~4.5% toward 3.5% as the base grows and the business matures.

ebit_margin.source: Assumption: FY2026 margin 4.18% (29,825/713,163), FY2025 4.31%; hold ~4.3% with modest mix benefit from advertising/membership offsetting investment.

tax_rate.source: Assumption: approx. 21% US federal statutory plus state and foreign taxes; Damodaran US Retail (General) effective rate is 19.1%, so 24% is conservative. Not taken directly from the filing.

capex_pct_revenue.source: FY2026 capex 26,642 / revenue 713,163 = 3.74%; FY2025 3.49%; hold ~3.7% reflecting ongoing automation and store investment.

wacc.source: CAPM: rf 4.86% (US Treasury 10Y par yield 2026-11-06) + relevered beta 0.83 x ERP 4.46% (Damodaran US, 2026-02-16) = 8.56% cost of equity. Beta: Damodaran Retail (General) cash-corrected unlevered 0.781 relevered at D/E 0.079 (industry D/E, no market price used) with 21% tax. Pretax cost of debt 5.07% (Damodaran), after tax 3.8%; weights 92.6%/7.4% -> WACC ~8.2%.

terminal_growth.source: Assumption: long-run nominal US growth/inflation, below the 4.86% risk-free rate.

net_debt.source: financial_statements derived: total debt 44,762 (LT debt noncurrent 34,624 + current 3,542 + short-term borrowings 6,596) - cash 10,727; no short-term investments; 10-K 0000104169-26-000055. Excludes leases.

diluted_shares.source: Weighted average diluted shares 8,022,000,000, us-gaap:WeightedAverageNumberOfDilutedSharesOutstanding, 10-K 0000104169-26-000055, expressed in millions
